title: Rothman Warns Against Sham Draft
body: Knesset Chairman Simcha Rothman vows to oppose a proposed military draft law if it's deemed a political façade, urging the High Court of Justice to stay out of legislative matters.

title: Terror Attack Survivor Visited
body: A delegation from Hatzalah and the Gilboa regional unit visited a local resident in Afula who survived a deadly terror attack last Friday. The visit aimed to strengthen the survivor and complete a powerful mitzvah.
